protocol.design: Deterministic direct-record query recovery under artificial information suppression

queries.label: Successes / attempts
queries.boundary: All completed attempted episodes in the declared condition, including failures

queries.label: Actual chunk generations
queries.boundary: Measured rollout generations; excludes model loading, reset and warm-up

queries.label: Measured denoise evaluations
queries.boundary: Actual denoise-method entries in measured rollouts; excludes warm-up

queries.label: Total outer rollout wall time
queries.boundary: Sum of outer rollout intervals over all attempts; runtime manifest defines included stages

queries.label: Mean wall time / attempt
queries.boundary: Total outer rollout wall time / all completed attempts; raw pooled mean, not equal-task weighting

queries.label: All-attempt wall time / success
queries.boundary: Total outer rollout wall time, including failed attempts, / successes; undefined at zero successes
queries.zero_denominator_rule: Known zero successes establishes undefined even when wall time is suppressed

protocol.reference: Completed records independently reconciled against retained step journals by this analyzer
protocol.information_contract: Reduced projections omit solver configuration, source, action-step schedules and timing. Condition identifiers are opaque to the recovery function. Only direct retained fields and the declared arithmetic are queried; the check does not assert that NFE is impossible to derive when solver configuration/source are available.
protocol.status_contract: recovered = defined value obtained; undefined = enough information establishes zero denominator; unknown = required information suppressed. Recovered and undefined count as answered when they match the reference.
protocol.limits: Finite deterministic mechanism check, not a reader study, natural disclosure experiment, independent empirical benefit estimate, or evidence of improved decisions. Full-projection success is a consistency check of deliberately retained fields, not a publication-level utility claim.

protocol_status: Fixed code-defined queries/projections; not external preregistration
outer_rollout_boundary: Rollout wall includes preprocessing, noise, generation, actions, simulator/rendering and journal writes; excludes reset, warmup, model load and environment creation.
